chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
In the expiation of an oath, a mudd of wheat, and a handful, so that the handful is included in its grinding and husking.

key_terms.مُدٌّ: A specific volume measure for food

ai.seo_question: What is the required amount of wheat for expiating an oath in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies the practical details of expiating an oath, requiring a mudd of wheat plus an extra handful to compensate for loss during grinding and husking. This reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on ensuring the full charitable obligation is met despite processing losses, distinguishing it from other schools that may calculate based on the final delivered amount.
